description: A time-boxed usage grant between CWI agents. Machine-readable coordination record ONLY — not a legal instrument, conveys no rights beyond what the two agents agree operationally. Auto-expiry is the product: every grant carries a hard window [issued_at, expires_at) and dies by default.

expires_at.description: Window closes (EXCLUSIVE), ISO-8601 UTC. expires_at <= issued_at is invalid.

grantee_urn.description: Receiving agent URN from the CWI agent roster

grantor_urn.description: Issuing agent URN from the CWI agent roster (e.g. agent:MUSE_CWI)

hash.description: SHA-256 of the canonical grant body (all fields except hash, sorted keys, compact JSON). Any post-issuance edit breaks the hash -> INVALID.

note.description: Optional human note. Never part of the hash contract.

scope.description: Usage scopes granted, e.g. ['gear.signal-boy.play-catalog','gear.signal-boy.attribution-required']. Attenuation only: a grant never widens.

status.description: Lifecycle state. 'expired' is written by sweep; 'revoked' by the grantor. Verification reads this field but computes expiry itself.

terms_ref.description: Machine-readable terms pointer, e.g. 'terms/standard-24h' — a template in the registry, not legal text

title: Clearance Window Grant
